flavours.name: Bishciaffed
flavours.description: Baked cheesecake gelato with spiced biscuit fudge and spiced biscuit crumb.
flavours.sensory: Tangy cheesecake with caramelised spiced-biscuit fudge and crumb - rich and warm, so it wants berry or citrus beside it.

pairs.why: Berry over cheesecake - the classic topping, served as a sorbet.
Bitter orange and warm spice, like a Christmas cheesecake.
Spiced biscuit and espresso - the cafe-counter pairing.
Tangy berry yoghurt keeps the cheesecake theme but lighter.

flavours.name: Chai-Lo
flavours.description: Sticky chai gelato and Milo gelato with Milo and Milo topping.
flavours.sensory: Warm chai spice against malty, crunchy Milo - sweet and cosy, so it likes a sharp fruit or bitter roast to wake it up.

pairs.why: Espresso turns chai and malt into a spiced mocha.
Bitter orange cuts the malt and sharpens the chai spice.
Masala chai and mango lassi - an Indian cafe cup.
Malt on malt - Milo meets malted milk cheesecake.

flavours.name: Cheese Louise
flavours.description: Maple syrup gelato with baked cheesecake chunks and maple caramel.
flavours.sensory: Sticky maple caramel with soft cheesecake chunks - very sweet, so it needs a sharp sorbet or a bitter edge.

pairs.why: Sharp lemon turns maple cheesecake into something like a lemon tart.
Berry on cheesecake, with the maple as the drizzle.
Espresso bitterness tames the maple - a pancake-breakfast pairing.
Two cheesecakes side by side - maple and spiced biscuit.

flavours.name: Coconut Pandan Tiramisu
flavours.description: Coconut tiramisu gelato with pandan-soaked biscuits.
flavours.sensory: Soft coconut and coffee with grassy, vanilla-like pandan biscuits - mellow and creamy, and good with a tropical sorbet lift.

pairs.why: Pandan and coconut again, lighter and cleaner as a sorbet.
Tart passionfruit lifts the coconut and cuts the coffee cream.
Classic and tropical tiramisu side by side.
Juicy mango leans into the coconut for a Southeast Asian cup.

flavours.name: Cowabunga
flavours.description: Jersey milk gelato with Malt 'O' Milk crunch and malted milk cheesecake.
flavours.sensory: Milky and malty with a biscuity crunch - gentle and sweet, so it takes well to chocolate depth or a sharp berry.

pairs.why: Strawberry milk with a malt biscuit - a milk-bar classic.
Dark chocolate gives the milk and malt a thickshake depth.
Malted milk meets Milo for a full milk-bar cup.
Tart passionfruit cuts through the cheesecake and milk.

flavours.name: Gorgeous Dave
flavours.description: Caramel gelato with caramel sauce and stroopwafels.
flavours.sensory: Buttery caramel on caramel with chewy waffle-biscuit pieces - very sweet, so it wants bitterness or a sharp fruit.

pairs.why: Stroopwafel over a coffee cup - the Dutch way.
Bitter orange cuts through double caramel.
Waffle and waffle - stroopwafel meets cone crunch.
Dark cocoa adds bitterness without more cream.

flavours.name: Mississippi Mud Pie
flavours.description: Custard gelato with dulce de leche, chocolate mudcake, chocolate topping and chocolate crumb.
flavours.sensory: Dense chocolate cake and milky caramel through custard - a whole dessert in a scoop, so give it something sharp or roasty.

pairs.why: Fresh berry cuts the mudcake like a chocolate-dipped strawberry.
Espresso turns cake, custard and caramel into a mocha.
Bitter orange with chocolate cake - a jaffa reset.
Plain custard to stretch out the chocolate and caramel.

flavours.name: Mr Messina
flavours.description: Fior di latte gelato with baked cheesecake, pretzel crust and pretzel fudge.
flavours.sensory: Salty pretzel and fudge around tangy cheesecake - rich and sweet-salty, so it wants a bright berry or citrus lift.

pairs.why: Strawberry on cheesecake, with pretzel for a salty edge.
Passionfruit, the classic cheesecake topping, cuts the fudge.
Salt meets salt - pretzel fudge and salted caramel.
Espresso keeps the fudge and cheesecake from getting heavy.

flavours.name: Number Two
flavours.description: Peanut gelato with chocolate brownie and dulce de leche.
flavours.sensory: Roasted peanut, fudgy brownie and milky caramel - a candy-bar scoop that needs sharp fruit or bitterness beside it.

pairs.why: Peanut and berry - a PB&J cup with a brownie.
Dark chocolate doubles the brownie and reins in the sugar.
Tangy berry yoghurt for a creamier PB&J.
Roast meets roasted peanut and cuts through the caramel.

flavours.name: Sassy Lassi
flavours.sensory: Juicy mango and tangy yoghurt, like a mango lassi - light and fruity, a natural lift beside the richer specials.

pairs.why: Passionfruit sharpens the mango into a full tropical cup.
Mango lassi and chai - an Indian cafe pairing.
Coconut softens the yoghurt tang; lychee adds a floral note.
Buttery macadamia and white chocolate anchor the fruit.
